text: Objective This objective is to train students to be able to work as teachers teaching sciences, physics, chemistry, biology and other courses in middle and primary schools or to work in institutions of higher learning, research institutions as professional personnel in the fields of teaching, scientific research or administration. Core courses Natural Geography, University Chemistry, University Physics, University Biology, Analytical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Electromagnetics, Structural Chemistry, Genetics, Science Course and Teaching Theory. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Education or Science is granted.
